review_output: {"summary":"I checked the claimed repairs in the four current sources, keeping the original ownership and persistence scope. Prior MAJOR 1 (pre-switch progress failure) is fixed. The stage moves to set_default only after onProgress succeeds. If that write fails, the caught result is uncertain at check_current with remoteMenuId set. That overwrites the local publication stage, and reconcile can then resolve it to failed or conflict. Prior MAJOR 2 (third-party default) is withdrawn: a timed-out setDefault may still complete later, so keeping it uncertain is correct. Prior MAJOR 3 is fixed: a lease failure after confirm returns uncertain, and reconcile can resolve it to synced when getDefault matches remoteMenuId. Prior MAJOR 4 is fixed: links are checked against the strict schema before prepare and claim, and every sync write re-validates the record. Prior MINOR (lost ownership) is fixed: it reads the latest tenant draft and returns uncertain. The credential race claim matches the code: the Serializable claim re-reads the account and compares its version. Two new MINOR issues remain, both cases where the draft stays locked forever even though the outcome is knowable or the channel is unchanged. Outside the task scope, as a proposal: a real setDefault timeout still locks the draft forever on purpose, with no admin or time-based way to resolve it. The full browser and provider tests have not been run.
